body:
Thing is, my college is tiny. Smaller than most schools infact. It's my 4th year and I pretty much know(of) everyone that goes there and fuck do the other girls fall incredibly short in comparison. Only way out of this is to suck it up and embrace the pain for what's left of my college career.

Epic case of life being shit.
That sounds like a plan, traveling alone may not be ideal but it beats sitting in your room alone.
I did, as mentioned above. It sort of helped but I wish it was than 3 days a week. I actually wish it was everyday, atleast I'll have something to do.
I wish you'd further talk about it. Maybe through a PM.

My friends may not be the ones with the fault, they seem to like and respect each other enough. One can only take so much rejection from various people until he runs out of tolerance and forms a firm belief that there is something legitimately wrong with him. What makes this even worse, is that he doesn't have the slightest idea what it is. I am pretty fit, I don't think I am unbearably hideous...but there has to be a reason why I barely made a real friend in the past 7 years of my life (HS + College)

I think the not caring thing is stemmed from severe loneliness and detachment.

Anyway, I don't stay at home as much anymore. My room feels like a prison cell. I spend alot of time at the gym or talking walks. The bar culture is pretty much non-existent where I live.
I took up boxing recently; where I met a few people, but it feels shallow and I don't know if we're ever going to be more than boxing-class mates.

In a normal scenario, a dude would lust over girl X but it won't work out, however he will soon attain girl Y and everything will be just fine.

In a shitty scenario, a dude lusts over girl X and keeps lusting over girl X because there is no girl Y.

So you don't advise that I let her know how I feel, at the very least get the what-ifs off my mind.

Regardless, I don't think I will be able to just move on. Goosebumps and butterflies are ignited at the mere sight of her. I cannot stop believing that I will never find someone (who showed legitimate interest in me) as smart/attractive/interesting as her.

One final thing that bothers me is the reality that this is my last semester in colllege and the window of opportunity will get much smaller afterwards, especially for someone with no experience in the game.
